args:
async (_event, repoPath, options) =>
    addWorktree(repoPath, options || {}, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, worktreePath, options) =>
    removeWorktree(repoPath, worktreePath, options || {}, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, branch) =>
    switchBranch(repoPath, branch, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, scope, baseRef) =>
    reviewList(repoPath, scope, baseRef, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, filePath, scope, baseRef, staged) =>
    reviewDiff(repoPath, filePath, scope, baseRef, staged, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, filePath) =>
    fileDiffVsHead(repoPath, filePath, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, filePath) =>
    reviewStage(repoPath, filePath ?? null, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, filePath) =>
    reviewUnstage(repoPath, filePath ?? null, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, filePath) =>
    reviewRevert(repoPath, filePath ?? null, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, ref) =>
    reviewRevParse(repoPath, ref, resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, message, push) =>
    reviewCommit(repoPath, message, Boolean(push), resolveGitBinary())

async (_event, repoPath, branches, numbers) =>
    reviewPrList(repoPath, resolveGhBinary(), branches, numbers)
async (_event: any, on: any) => applySecretStorageEncryption(on === true)

async (_event: Electron.IpcMainInvokeEvent, opts?: { force?: boolean }): Promise<UpdaterStatusWire> =>
    checkUpdates({ force: Boolean(opts?.force) }).catch((error: Error): UpdaterStatusWire => ({
      supported: true,
      branch: readDesktopUpdateConfig().branch,
      error: 'check-failed',
      message: error?.message || String(error),
      fetchedAt: Date.now()
    }))

(event: unknown, on: unknown, profile: unknown): void =>
    recorder.setEnabled(senderId(event), profile, on === true)

(event: unknown, sent: unknown): void =>
    recorder.ack(senderId(event), sent === true)
(_event: unknown, sent: unknown): void => recorder.ack(sent === true)
